name: FirstValueByGroupNode
label: First Value By Group
description: Adds a column with the first (top) value of a source column within each group. Optionally order groups by an ordering column.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to compute first values for.

fields.name: GroupByColumns
fields.label: Group By Columns
fields.description: Comma-separated columns that define the groups.

fields.name: SourceColumn
fields.label: Source Column
fields.description: The column whose first value per group is retrieved.

fields.name: OrderByColumn
fields.label: Order By Column
fields.description: Optional column to order rows within each group before picking the first value. Leave empty to use row order.

fields.name: Ascending
fields.label: Ascending
fields.description: True to order ascending, false for descending. Defaults to true.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the result column. Defaults to '<SourceColumn>_FirstValue'.
